name: Ischia (Italy)
description: Blue field with a yellow central panel charged with the crowned municipal arms of Ischia (a pyramid of cannonballs on light blue) within branches and the inscription CITTA' DI ISCHIA above.
history: Municipal flag of Ischia, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ischia arms — pyramid of cannonballs on light blue, crowned, within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DI ISCHIA above
